summary:
The following completed inter-band ENDC band combinations for 3 band DL with 3 bands UL are added from RAN4 #92bis

1. R4-1912586,TP for TR 37.716-33: DC_66A_n5A-n260 and DC_66A_n5A-n261, Qualcomm Incorporated
R4-1911252, TP for TR 37.716-33_DC_3A_n79A-n258A,ZTE Corporation

It shall be noted there are no new TPs input  for the combinations.

Correct BWChannel_CA  – GBChannel(1) - GBChannel(2) to BWChannel_CA  – 2*BWGB
Add a new row to capture the information of Adjacent channel centre frequency offset.
Sentence improvement for the adjacent aggregated channel bandwidth.
Additional LTE band(B40) for UE category 1bis can be supported from Rel-14 in release independence manner
Frequency band number B40 and reference sensitivity requirements are introduced
Adding operating band as n258 for NS_202.

For DC_41-n41,AMPR also adopts the value for single RAT in TS 36.101 and TS 38.101-1 respectively under single UL transmission mode.
Clarify the transmission bandwith configuration shall be the maximum transmission bandwidth configuration among mixed numerology.
Correction on the reference for SEM-13,high threshold.
Clrify the 6dB PSD difference for MCG and SCG is for the transmission power after scaling.

Make it clear that the channel bandwidths for E-UTRA or NR carrier should be at least supported in one of the BCS indicated in E-UTRA bandwidth combination sets or NR bandwidth combination sets if reported.
Throughput and maximum throughput definition is added.
